dashboard_trackers.notes: Iran's Foreign Ministry said Tehran and Oman made progress on common principles and operational mechanisms for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz after several rounds of deputy-minister talks. dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: The exact lanes produced no new qualifying Turkish event. No verified Turkish combat entry, force movement, official nuclear-doctrine shift or long-range launch surfaced. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Post-06Z India-Pakistan returns were youth-hockey results; older Rawalakot coverage concerned internal clashes in Pakistan-administered Kashmir. No fresh Line of Control exchange, Indian force movement or interstate strike was verified. Raw 15; coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No verified post-06Z border strike, crossing closure or sustained interstate clash surfaced. Militant violence inside Pakistan and older Afghan airstrike coverage do not establish a new state-on-state threshold. Raw 46; coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.notes: The deadly Ukraine-linked Caspian vessel strike and continuing battlefield attacks remain the latest material evidence. dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new PLA quarantine, Taiwan blockade declaration, amphibious concentration or cross-Strait clash surfaced. The newly reported U.S.-Japan-Philippines exercise belongs to south_china_sea and is not double-counted here. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.notes: Sudanese army recapture claims and El Obeid warnings remain the latest reporting. No post-06Z independently verified new strategic capture, direct external-force entry or distinct Port Sudan event surfaced. Raw 92; coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE

dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh clash, verified large force movement, transition breakdown or Abyei security shift surfaced in the full exact-lane review. Raw 19; coupled 19
